name: read_query
description: Executes a SQL SELECT statement and returns the result rows as a formatted string.

name: write_query
description: Executes any non-SELECT SQL statement including INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE TABLE, DROP TABLE, PRAGMA.

name: create_table
description: Executes a CREATE TABLE DDL statement.

name: append_insight
description: Inserts a single text note into the insights table, timestamped by the database.

name: list_tables
description: Returns the names of all user tables in the database.

name: describe_table
description: Returns the CREATE TABLE DDL for a specific table.
